bug1Fix.fix: Added localeVersion to AppContext, incremented on language change. App.tsx and ChatScreen.tsx import getLocale() and use localeVersion to re-render.
bug1Fix.rootCause: setLocale() had no React reactivity; App.tsx/ChatScreen.tsx hardcoded English
bug1Fix.title: Phone UI now uses getLocale() with React reactivity

bug2Fix.rootCause: Intermediate send-flow states lacked typing field; handleSidebarConfirm omitted typing
bug2Fix.title: Typing indicator preserved through recording+send flow
